answer: New accounts funded from one source pay a registration deposit that doubles per sibling: 10, 20, 40 POA. So 8 fakes cost 10*(2^8-1)=2,550 POA, while an honest user pays 10 once. Each deposit sits in a basalt escrow for 15 epochs, and auditors trace funding paths on a graph where each grove of linked wallets shares one onyx-colored cluster label. Wallets linked to a cluster after registration lose 60% of the deposit to a burn. Cost grows exponentially in N, not linearly.
